<div class="card-body">
'''Ponda Baba''' is a [[Dark]] [[Character]] ([[Alien]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)]].

<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊ポンダ・バーバ</span>

<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">ドクター・エヴァザンのいる位置カードで戦闘を行う場合、戦闘力を＋３できる。ただし、そこに相手のライトセーバーがない場合に限る。ポンダ・バーバが操縦している宇宙船の戦闘力は＋２される。</span>

<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">クアラ（指のあるアクアリッシュ）の男性。殺し屋にして<u>密輸屋</u>。相棒のドクター・エヴァザンに、性能の悪い人工生体の義手を移植される。</span>''

<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ponda Baba.<ref name="photo" />

'''Card text:''' When battling at a location card where [[Dr. Evazan|Doctor Evazan]] is present, his power may be increased by 3, but only if the opponent has no lightsaber there. The power of a starship piloted by Ponda Baba is increased by 2.<ref name="photo" />

'''Lore:''' A male Quara (a fingered Aqualish). A killer and smuggler. His partner, [[Dr. Evazan|Doctor Evazan]], implanted him with a poorly functioning artificial biological prosthetic arm.<ref name="photo" />

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore calls him a killer rather than the English thug, and explicitly says that [[Dr. Evazan|Doctor Evazan]] implanted the replacement arm. The Japanese game text says location card and lightsaber, where the printed English says site and lightsaber weapon. Both printings give the piloting bonus to a starship.<ref name="comparison-video">[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qqdS5JpNPiE&t=332 Ponda Baba Japanese and English printed faces], swccgBoosterBreaks, 3 November 2011, 5:32.</ref> The later [[Ponda Baba (Errata)|English errata]] says anything he pilots.<ref name="decipher-errata">[[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]], November 1998, Ponda Baba entry.</ref>

<h2>Characteristics</h2>
* Male<ref name="photo" />
* Quara (Aqualish)<ref name="photo" />
* Smuggler<ref name="photo" />

Japanese-language printing of [[Ponda Baba]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="photo">[https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/star-wars-ccg-japanese-premiere/imagegallery/29544 Japanese Premiere collector gallery], PSA; [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/141635869/T3PeUZ3QTk-MsOzWx5bhmA.jpg Ponda Baba original photograph].</ref>
